Asset type: transparent PNG game character cutout.
Input image 1: edit target, not a style reference.
Primary request: Extract only the entire yellow round character, including antenna, arms, hands, short legs and white striped boots. Remove the purple scene, floor, patterned mat and every ground shadow. Keep the exact existing happy facial expression and body silhouette. Keep the original 4:3 canvas, composition and subject placement.
Constraints: This is precise background removal only. Preserve the existing subject as faithfully as possible; do not redraw, restyle, relight, smooth, reconstruct, change pose or alter facial features. Change only the alpha outside the subject. Retain clean antialiased edges and fine hair/whiskers without background halos. No new text, props, frames, outline, drop shadow or invented content. Output real RGBA transparency with zero alpha outside the subject, not a painted checkerboard or solid background.
